newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down ending a long mkt rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down ending a long mkt rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down amid profit-taking on blue chips ending a lingering market rally ahead of Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.

"The prices fell because investors booked profit. A market correction is due after a week-long rally," said broker Mahboob Morshed. The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index fell 5.79 points or 0.34 percent at 1,655.02 on a turnover of 167.2 million taka. Of the 109 issues traded, 54 closed up, 50 ended down and five were unchanged.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals fell 13.04 taka to 147.94, Bata Shoe lost 20.80 taka to 215.46, BD Lamps gained 10.17 to 4,508.98.
